t: A hackable smartwatch you program in JavaScript from a web browser.
steps: Buy a Bangle.js 2 from the Espruino shop or a maker store.
Charge it with the magnetic cable on the back.
Open the Bangle.js App Loader in Chrome or Edge on a computer or phone.
Connect to the watch over Bluetooth and update its firmware.
Install a new watch face from the app loader to see how apps arrive.
Open the Espruino Web IDE and connect to the watch.
Try a first program that writes "Hello" on the screen and buzzes once.
meta: Open Code. From $150. A few stores.
